summary: Your fifteenth Sunday review. You answer 10 questions on golden sets, metrics, judges and the table with a confidence number, start a results table of every change, extend your glossary, run the scoring from cold, check your applications, tag week 15 and plan week 16.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 10 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Start your results table with the baseline and an honest what-got-worse column
Glossary: add 9 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold: database, ingest, check_golden and run_golden, and compare with the baseline
Count this week's applications and fix the real reason if there were none
Run git tag week-15, then plan week 16 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 2 or 3 applications
Play the Evaluation Mix-up game to the end and see your score
